root = Stack([header, topGrid, tabsSection], 16)

scheduled = Query("host_listScheduledPayments", {}, [])
payees = Query("host_listPayees", {}, [])
topGrid = Grid([totalBalanceCard, accountsSurface], 2, 16)
totalBalanceCard = Surface([totalBalanceStack], "Overview")
totalBalanceStack = Stack([balanceStat, countStat, transferNote], 12)
balanceStat = Stat("Total Liquid Funds", @Sum(accounts.balance), "money", null, "accent")
countStat = Stat("Active Accounts", @Count(accounts), "number")
transferNote = Callout("Transfers from your checking account process instantly.", "info", "Instant Settlement")
accountsSurface = Surface([accountTable], "Your Accounts")
accountTable = DataTable(accounts, [{key: "name", label: "Account"}, {key: "kind", label: "Type", format: "label"}, {key: "mask", label: "Account #"}, {key: "balance", label: "Balance", format: "money", align: "end"}])
tabsSection = Tabs([transferTab, scheduledTab])
transferTab = {label: "New Transfer", content: transferSurface}
scheduledTab = {label: "Scheduled & Payees", content: scheduledGrid}
transferSurface = Surface([transferForm], "Move Funds")
transferForm = Form([fromAccountSelect, toAccountSelect, amountInput, memoInput], "host_transferMoney", "Execute Transfer")
fromAccountSelect = Select(accounts, "From Account", "name", "name", "Select source account")
toAccountSelect = Select(accounts, "To Account / Recipient", "name", "name", "Select destination account")
amountInput = Input("Amount", null, "Enter transfer amount", "number")
memoInput = Input("Memo", null, "Reference note (e.g., Savings allocation)", "text")
scheduledGrid = Grid([scheduledCard, payeesCard], 2, 16)
scheduledCard = Surface([scheduledTable], "Scheduled Payments & Transfers")
scheduledTable = DataTable(scheduled, [{key: "payeeName", label: "Payee"}, {key: "amount", label: "Amount", format: "money", align: "end"}, {key: "nextDate", label: "Next Date", format: "date"}, {key: "cadence", label: "Cadence", format: "label"}])
payeesCard = Surface([payeesList], "Saved Payees")
payeesList = CardList(payees, "name", "kind", [])
